packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates land together; major updates get a pull request each (dependabot.yml's npm group).

typescript-eslint (through eslint-config-next) supports only TypeScript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, and with TypeScript 7 `eslint .` crashes while loading its parser (#26). Hold TypeScript at that range; raise or remove this rule when a typescript-eslint release supports the newer TypeScript.
